facts.text: Under The Denison Commitment, families with a total family income of $100,000 or less pay $0 toward tuition.

sources.title: The Denison Commitment | Admission & Financial Aid
sources.quote: Families with a total income less than $100,000 will pay $0 for tuition.

facts.text: Denison meets 100% of demonstrated financial need for all admitted students, including international students.
